thread:
maya: opened a tiny docs PR to consolidate air-gapped guidance for KMS/HSM on private installs. Two quick asks: (1) a clear minimal example for mirroring images and (2) how/where to place CA certs for both containerd and CRI-O. dropping the PR link here for context.

alex: link? i can add examples and a short troubleshooting checklist.

maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1187. the current page (docs/private/onprem/kms_hsm_airgap.md) has bits scattered across sections. customers keep asking the same three things so i consolidated into one subsection but want a reviewer.

linh: skimmed it. suggest: (a) single skopeo sync example showing dest dir + dest-creds, (b) imagePullSecrets snippet, (c) host CA steps for Debian (update-ca-certificates) and RHEL (update-ca-trust), and (d) short CRI-O restart example. keep everything copy-paste friendly.

sam: agree. also add a one-line command to validate certs with openssl s_client so support can quickly triage TLS errors.

alex: drafting the snippets now. proposing these minimal commands:

alex:
```bash
# sync with skopeo to local dir mirror
skopeo sync --src docker --dest dir --dest-creds '<user>:<pass>' docker://registry.redwood.ai/redwood/kms:stable dir:/opt/redwood-mirror

# Debian/RHEL trust install
sudo cp mirror-ca.pem /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/mirror-ca.crt && sudo update-ca-certificates && sudo systemctl restart containerd
sudo cp mirror-ca.pem /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/mirror-ca.crt && sudo update-ca-trust extract && sudo systemctl restart crio

# quick TLS check
openssl s_client -connect mirror.internal:443 -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
```

alex: and a compact imagePullSecrets secret example for the redwood-system namespace:

alex:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: mirror-pull-secret
  namespace: redwood-system
type: kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson
stringData:
  .dockerconfigjson: |
    {"auths": {"mirror.internal:443": {"auth": "<base64>"}}}
```

linh: tidy. one small addition: include a `kubectl auth can-i` check to verify the kms serviceaccount can read secrets if the installer expects that. also mention that serviceaccounts must be namespaced (redwood-system).

alex: adding this verification snippet:

alex:
```bash
kubectl auth can-i get secrets --namespace redwood-system --as=system:serviceaccount:redwood-system:kms-sa
```

maya: nice. docs-bot will complain if we add a subsection without TOC update and lint. please run make docs-lint and add a short CHANGELOG entry under docs.

docs-bot: reminder: run `make docs-lint`. update docs/TOC.md for new subsection and add a one-line CHANGELOG entry under "docs". absolute internal links will fail linkcheck; prefer docs/reference/* paths.

sam: i'll take care of the backport to release/1.2.x after merge; a few customers on that branch are scheduling installs next week and this answers repetitive questions.

marta-cs: thanks  can you add a one-line customer-facing note i can paste into our onboarding checklist? something like "For air-gapped installs: mirror images, install mirror CA on hosts, restart CRI (containerd/CRI-O), and set imagePullSecrets in redwood-system." keeps it short for CS.

alex: added that line under a new "Customer checklist" subsection and pushed changes. ran the linter locally and fixed a couple heading-level warnings.

linh: CI linkcheck flagged an internal RFC link in the migration section; i replaced it with docs/reference/hsm-migration.md and updated the anchor. pushed a tiny fix.

maya: great. once CI goes green please merge and backport. @sam can you ping @marta-cs after the backport? she can slot the checklist into the customer runbook.

sam: will do. merging when CI finishes. thanks all!
